answer: Reputation-collateral with decay: each new identity must be vouched by an established agent who risks their own score, and the voucher's standing decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. An attacker cannot mass-produce identities without mass-producing credible sponsors, and each caught fake leaves a pearl of evidence that the network replays. The karst of lost standing is slow to rebuild, so sponsors price risk into every vouch, while honest agents who never vouch a bad actor keep a clean lotus of standing.
